headline: Real turnaround, but already priced in
chart_note: 52-week range: $24.05 - $142.35. Currently $105.16, up over 300% from the 52-week low.
why_today: Q2 revenue jumped 25% YoY to $16.1B, the strongest growth in over 15 years, driven by AI demand. Foundry losses narrowed sharply from -71.7% to -36.2% operating margin - real progress, though the unit still lost $2.1B for the quarter.
pro_1: Foundry turnaround is showing up in the numbers, not just guidance - losses cut nearly in half in a year
pro_2: Revenue growth of 25% is Intel's best in over a decade
con_1: Analyst consensus is only Hold (63% hold, just 31% buy) - Wall Street wants more proof before conviction
con_2: Dividend suspended, beta of 2.23 (highly volatile), and a negative PEG ratio reflecting still-fragile earnings
